title: Events
subtitle: Organise a meal: the guests, their constraints, the menu, the portions and the shopping.
delete-confirm: Delete "{name}" with its guests, its menu, its history and its generated shopping plan?
empty: No event yet. Create one to organise your next meal.
guest-count: No guest attending | {count} guest attending | {count} guests attending
not-found: This event does not exist or was deleted.
reopened: The event changed: it is a draft again and must be planned again.

form.name: Name of the event
form.cook-help: The restrictions of this person that also count when they cook apply to the whole preparation.
form.leftover-portions-help: Portions to plan on top of the guests, for leftovers.

guests.summary-persons: Nobody at the table | {count} person at the table | {count} persons at the table
guests.help: Tick the persons you invite. For each one, say whether they come and adjust their appetite for this meal if needed.
guests.no-person: No person yet. Add your guests under "People" first.

constraints.help: This is what the menu must respect, from the restrictions of the persons who attend and of the person who cooks. Read them before you choose the recipes.
constraints.shared-empty: No constraint applies to the whole meal.
constraints.overrides-help: An exception changes how far a restriction reaches for this meal or for one dish, for example when a guest accepts that only their own portion is concerned. Each exception is recorded in the history of the event with its reason.
constraints.override-history-notice: This exception will be recorded in the history of the event, with its reason and its date. The profile of the person does not change.
constraints.override-menu-item-help: Leave empty to apply the exception to the whole event.
constraints.override-reason-help: At least 3 characters. For example: "Agreed with her on the phone".
constraints.override-delete-confirm: Delete this exception? The restriction will go back to its usual scope, and the deletion will be noted in the history.
constraints.override-nobody: Neither a guest nor the person who cooks has a restriction: there is nothing to adapt.

menu.help: Build the menu dish by dish. A dish can have several recipes: each guest then gets the one that respects their restrictions. Nothing is fixed automatically: you decide.
menu.empty: The menu is empty. Add a first dish.
menu.unassigned: No recipe of this dish suits {names}. Add a compatible variant. | No recipe of this dish suits: {names}. Add a compatible variant.
menu.variant-help: A variant is another recipe for the same dish, for example for a guest with a restriction.
menu.assignments-help: By default, each guest gets the first recipe that is compatible with their restrictions. You can choose by hand: a choice that breaks a restriction is reported.
menu.unsaved: The menu changed: save it to update the checks and the portions.
menu.missing-recipe: Choose a recipe for each variant, or remove the empty variants, before you save.

portions.help: Each recipe is multiplied to serve the persons who eat it, according to their appetite.
portions.empty: The menu is empty: add dishes in the "Menu" step.
portions.no-recipe: This dish has no recipe yet.
portions.missing-servings: This recipe does not say how many portions it makes, so the quantities cannot be computed. Set its number of servings in the recipe.
portions.not-cooked: Nobody eats this recipe: there is no need to cook it.

review.blocking-help: This item breaks a restriction. The event cannot be planned until it is fixed. | These {count} items break a restriction. The event cannot be planned until they are fixed.
review.to-verify-help: Nobody verified this item. Read the label or verify the food. | Nobody verified these {count} items. Read the labels or verify the foods.
review.checklist-help: Tick as you go. The ticks are not saved.
review.checklist-empty: No special precaution for this meal.
review.acknowledge: I saw the unverified item and I will deal with it before the meal. | I saw the {count} unverified items and I will deal with them before the meal.
review.planned-help: The event is planned. If it changes (guests, menu, exceptions), it becomes a draft again.
review.blocker-no-guest: Add at least one guest who attends before you plan the event.
review.blocker-no-menu: Add at least one recipe to the menu before you plan the event.
review.blocker-blocking: Fix the issues above before you plan the event.

status-set.DRAFT: The event is a draft again

review.shopping-help: Computes the quantities to buy for this menu. If the shopping plan of this event already exists, it opens.
review.history-help: What changed in this event, most recent first.

history.STATUS_DRAFT: Set back to draft by hand

history-reason.ASSIGNMENT_CHANGED: the assignment of a dish changed
history-reason.EVENT_CHANGED: the cook or the extra portions changed
